sentence_stem: Although the novel was long and complicated,
correct_completion: many readers still finished it in a week.
full_sentence: Although the novel was long and complicated, many readers still finished it in a week.
acceptable_variants: many readers still read it quickly.
the book still found a large audience.

options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a result, not a contrast. The clause needs to contrast with the difficulty of the novel.

options.text: many readers still finished it in a week.
the author was born in Spain.
options.why_wrong: This gives background about the author but does not contrast with the difficulty of the novel.
This describes the book's appearance but does not complete the contrast set up by 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', the second clause must express a contrast with the first part of the sentence. Learners often choose a cause connector such as 'so' here because cause and result feel natural, but English 'although' always signals contrast.
translation: Aunque la novela era larga y complicada, muchos lectores todavía la terminaron en una semana.
